name: Salad Dressing
description: A thickened salad dressing made by boiling a mixture of eggs, sugar, flour, mustard, water, and vinegar, finished with butter.

recipeInstructions.text: Beat eggs and add sugar and dry ingredients.
Boil water and vinegar together.
Pour egg mixture into vinegar-water mixture and boil until it thickens, stirring continually.
Take off heat and stir in 1 Tbsp butter.

_similar.name: Hot Potato Salad
_similar.description: A warm potato salad dressed with a tangy vinegar-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: In a saucepan, combine the white vinegar, flour, and water. Heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Add the butter, salt, pepper, and sugar to the vinegar mixture. Bring to a boil.
Pour the hot dressing over the sliced potatoes.

_similar.keywords: hot potato salad, vinegar dressing, warm salad

_similar.name: Caesar Dressin' Salad
_similar.description: A homemade Caesar salad dressing made with egg yolks, garlic, lemon juice, and Parmesan cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Put all ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend for 2 minutes.
Can be kept in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

_similar.name: Pickled Eggs
_similar.description: Tangy pickled eggs made with vinegar, mustard, and spices, perfect for snacking or as a side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the vinegar, water, mustard, salt, pepper, and onion pieces in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil.
Pour the hot pickling liquid over the hard-boiled eggs.
Let the eggs stand in the pickling liquid for 5 days before serving.

_similar.keywords: pickled eggs, tangy snack, preserved eggs

_similar.name: Sliced Bean Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and sweet pickled bean salad made with green or yellow beans, perfect for serving with onion and cream.

recipeInstructions.text: Slice the beans and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork.
Drain the cooked beans and pack them into jars.
In a saucepan, bring the sugar, water, vinegar, and salt to a boil to make the syrup.
Pour the hot syrup over the beans in the jars.
To serve, pour off the liquid and add chopped onion and cream.

_similar.keywords: pickled bean salad, sweet and tangy, preserved beans

recipeInstructions.text: In the top of a double boiler, whisk together the egg, egg yolk, sugar, cornstarch, and mustard.
Slowly whisk in the vinegar and water mixture, then cook over hot water, stirring constantly, until the dressing thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in the softened butter and mayonnaise. Chill the dressing.
